i.norm:
Verifies that {@link TaiInstant#isAfter(TaiInstant)} returns false when the receiver lies earlier on the time-line than the argument.

The earlier instant is built with a negative nanosecond adjustment, which {@link TaiInstant#ofTaiSeconds(long, long)} normalises by borrowing one second: 883 seconds with -784 nanos becomes 882 seconds and 999,999,216 nanos (1,000,000,000 - 784 = 999,999,216). It therefore remains well before the later instant at 86,400 seconds.
Negative nano adjustment borrows a second during normalisation.
